title: Receiver
description: A single intended receiver. siteName, authorisationNumber, receiptAddress and contactDetails are all required.

authorisationNumber.description: Receiver environmental permit or exemption number, in a valid UK format.

receiptAddress.description: Address the waste will be received at. postcode is required; fullAddress is optional.

contactDetails.description: How to contact the receiving site. At least one of emailAddress or phoneNumber is required.
